name: Local Private RAG (Ollama + ChromaDB, airgapped)
note: Every task runs a real command with TEST_MODE=true (tests/conftest.py): the kit's in-memory store and a synthetic embedder, so no Ollama, ChromaDB or network is needed. Where the production path matters the client is stubbed at the boundary: a fake Chroma collection records the where clause and a fake httpx client records outbound URLs. Not verified: real ChromaDB persistence, real Ollama generation, and caller identity (tenant and clearance are asserted in the request body; the kit has no authentication). The groundedness scorer is a lexical-overlap heuristic. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Zero-egress airgap guard
eval_tasks.instruction: Every outbound request must be checked against the loopback and compose-alias allowlist before it is made, health must report the real airgap state, and the LLM server must have no route out.
assertions: loopback, localhost, ollama and chroma are allowed
public hosts, userinfo and subdomain look-alikes, metadata IPs and non-http schemes are blocked
embedding and generation to a blocked host raise before any HTTP request is issued
turning the restriction off is the only way to lift the guard, and it defaults to on
health reports airgap_safe false and degraded for a non-local endpoint or when restriction is off
the ollama compose service publishes no port and sits only on an internal network
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "hosts_are or egress or health or llm_server or embedding_to or generation_to or unrestricted" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Tenant isolation and classification clearance
eval_tasks.instruction: Retrieval must be pinned to the caller's tenant and clearance on both the in-memory path and the ChromaDB query, and chunk ids must be deterministic and tenant-scoped.
assertions: tenant A never retrieves tenant B chunks, in memory and over HTTP
each clearance level sees only its own and lower classes
the ChromaDB where clause pins tenant_id and the allowed classification list
ingest tags every chunk with tenant and classification
unknown fields, bad classifications and missing tenants are rejected
re-ingesting is idempotent and the same document id in two tenants does not collide
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "tenants_are or clearance or chromadb or schemas_reject or cross_tenant or reingesting or same_document or chunk_ids" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Prompt-injection boundary and groundedness guardrail
eval_tasks.instruction: Retrieved text must be confined to one delimited context block it cannot close, and offline evaluation must flag hallucinated answers without any network call.
assertions: context delimiter look-alikes in any case or spacing are stripped
the prompt has exactly one context block and the user question sits outside it
a hallucinated answer is flagged and a grounded one is not
evaluation issues no network request
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "lookalikes or delimited_context or outside_the_context or hallucinated or grounded_answer or evaluation_makes" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Error hygiene, CORS, chunk and input limits, container hardening
eval_tasks.instruction: Failures must return a generic 500, a wildcard CORS origin must never be honoured, no chunk may exceed its size, inputs must be bounded, and the image must run non-root without credentials in the env template.
assertions: query, ingest and evaluate failures return a generic 500 with no host, secret or path
a wildcard origin is dropped and unlisted origins get no allow header
no chunk exceeds the requested size, including an oversized single paragraph
ingest and query size limits are enforced by the schema
the final Dockerfile stage drops to a numeric UID >= 10000
credential-named keys in .env.example are empty and egress stays restricted
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "generic_500 or wildcard or cors or chunk or ingest_limits or non_root or env_example" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
assertions: pytest exits 0 across tests/
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
